Attached: 1 image

Flipping the site into Arabic took one flag in the page builder and almost no CSS. I'd written nearly every margin and border as inline-start or inline-end from the first day. So dir=rtl on the html element mirrors the whole page by itself, nav and phone mock included. One margin-left survives in the phone layout. It's a zero, so it gets away with it.

#WebDev #CSS #RTL #i18n
